UNDER THE HOOD

Structural, transparent, deterministic.

Every four seconds the opponent recomputes up to six strongest directed LC4→DNg108 routes with distinct final gates. A Cut removes a type group and all incident connections. A Jam masks it for one pulse. Route capacity is the weakest measured edge on a path.

SCORE = TARGET SUPPRESSION − COLLATERAL PENALTY

The model uses structural connections only. It does not include membrane dynamics, physiology, neuromodulation, plasticity or embodiment.
VERIFIED DATA PROVENANCE

This level is derived from MaleCNS v1.0.

Nodes are real cross-matched MaleCNS cell-type groups. Edges are measured male synapse totals from the official mcns_fw_edge_comp.feather artifact. The level uses LC4 as source, DNg108 as target, and DNa13 plus DNa02 as protected outputs.

17 REAL TYPE GROUPS · 35 DISPLAYED EDGES
MINIMUM EDGE WEIGHT: 120 MALE SYNAPSES

The circuit was curated from the official table for gameplay and is licensed CC BY. Courier flies visualize graph routing; they are not measured neural activity or evidence of behaviour.
